tweets.text:
JUST IN — Columbia University has submitted to the Trump Administration after trying to go it alone without huge amounts of taxpayer largesse for a whopping 4 months. Columbia has agreed to:

-End all illegal race-based discrimination in hiring and admissions (read anti-white and anti-Asian), and submit to independent oversight to ensure compliance.

-Pay $200 million in fines to the federal government to settle claims of past illegal discrimination at the school.

-Provide its hiring and admissions data to the federal government as a guarantee against future illegal discrimination.

-Reduce its sky-high share of foreign enrollment.

-Create new faculty positions in order to increase intellectual diversity.

-Punish the perpetrators of disruptive and illegal "protests" last year, while implementing new rules to ensure illegal, unpermited, vandalism-fests don't happen again.

If the Ivy League can't stand by its radical and discriminatory policies, then the rest of America's schools don't stand a chance. Onward.
